<style>
.ge{position:relative;max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 1rem 2rem}
.ge-bar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:.5rem .9rem;margin:.5rem 0}
.ge-field,.ge-check{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.35rem;margin:0;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--site-ink-2)}
.ge-field>span:first-child{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.7rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}
.ge-field select,.ge-field input[type=number],.ge-field input[type=text]{width:auto;font-size:.85rem;padding:.15rem .4rem}
.ge-field input[type=number]{width:4.4rem}
.ge-field select{padding-right:1.8rem}
.ge-field input[type=range]{width:7rem}
.ge-field output{min-width:2.2rem;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.ge-title{min-width:12rem}
.ge-play{min-width:5.5rem}
.ge-play.ge-on{background:var(--site-accent-dk);border-color:var(--site-accent-dk)}
.ge-status{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.75rem;color:var(--site-ink-2)}
.ge-note{font-size:.85rem;color:#9a5a00;margin:.2rem 0}
.ge-staff{min-height:110px;margin:.4rem 0;overflow:hidden}
.ge-staff .ls-on,.ge-staff .ls-on *{fill:#d6336c;stroke:#d6336c}
.ge-block{display:grid;gap:2px;margin:0 0 .9rem;align-items:stretch}
.ge-name{font-size:.78rem;text-align:left;border:0;background:none;padding:0 .3rem 0 0;color:var(--site-ink);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
button.ge-name:hover{color:var(--site-accent-dk);text-decoration:underline}
.ge-name.ge-muted{color:var(--site-ink-3);text-decoration:line-through}
.ge-cell{aspect-ratio:1;min-width:0;padding:0;border:1px solid var(--site-border);border-radius:3px;background:#fff;color:var(--site-ink);font-size:.95rem;line-height:1;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;touch-action:none;user-select:none;overflow:hidden}
.ge-cell.ge-odd{background:#faf7f2}
.ge-cell.ge-beat{border-left-color:var(--site-ink-3)}
.ge-cell.ge-barline{border-left:2px solid var(--site-ink)}
.ge-cell:hover{border-color:var(--site-accent-dk)}
.ge-cell.ge-on{background:var(--site-accent-bg);border-color:var(--site-accent)}
.ge-cell.ge-acc{font-weight:700;font-size:1.25rem;background:rgba(63,194,180,.34)}
.ge-cell.ge-ghost{font-size:.6rem;color:var(--site-ink-2)}
.ge-cell.ge-txt{font-size:.62rem;font-family:var(--font-mono)}
.ge-cell.ge-quiet{border-style:dashed}
.ge-cell.ge-now{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #d6336c}
.ge-word{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.68rem;text-align:center;color:var(--site-ink-3);overflow:hidden}
.ge-word.ge-beat{color:var(--site-ink);font-weight:600}
.ge-word.ge-now{color:#d6336c}
.ge-pop{position:absolute;z-index:20;width:250px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--site-border);border-radius:6px;box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.16);padding:.3rem}
.ge-pop-head{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.7rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--site-ink-2);padding:.2rem .4rem}
.ge-pop-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;width:100%;border:0;background:none;text-align:left;font-size:.85rem;padding:.2rem .4rem;border-radius:4px}
.ge-pop-item:hover,.ge-pop-item.ge-current{background:var(--site-accent-bg)}
.ge-pop-item .ge-cell{width:1.5rem;flex:none;cursor:inherit}
.ge-link{font-size:.85rem}
.ge-hint{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--site-ink-2);flex-basis:100%}
@media (max-width:600px){.ge{padding:0 .5rem 2rem}.ge-name{font-size:.62rem}.ge-cell{font-size:.7rem}.ge-cell.ge-acc{font-size:.85rem}.ge-word{font-size:.55rem}.ge-field input[type=range]{width:5rem}}
</style>
